verdict.rationale: Check documents its own Postman collection covering companies, workplaces, employees, and payrolls. That is a first-party, machine-readable API artifact, but it is a demo collection rather than a confirmed full OpenAPI spec. The llms.txt probe calls the docs an "API specification" but does not show a downloadable spec file. Missing for 10: an explicitly downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file, documentation of the spec's coverage of all endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This guide will run you through our Postman collection that demonstrates how to create companies, workplaces, employees, and payrolls
Welcome to the API specification for Check!
